{{Top}}
{{Quote|We are lowly farmers from a village in the poorer parts of this planet...|Ramiz|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 8">[[Star Wars (1977) 8|''Star Wars'' (1977) 8]]</ref>}}
'''Farmers''' were individuals who worked on [[Farm/Legends|farms]]. [[Moisture farmer/Legends|Moisture farmers]] worked on desert worlds to harvest water.

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] is described in the original [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'']] script as a "'''farm boy'''."
